tei:div.tei:p: (13)dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas 'phang ba zor gyi las rim gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs// (14)

dam bca' gsum ldan brgya byin rdo rje'i mtshon// nyes byed lha min klad par bsnyil ba bzhin// srid gsum zla bral ldog med gnam lcags thog /srid rtsa'i snying la 'bebs pa'i mgon des skyongs// bka' gter zab rgu kun gyi phul// mkha' 'gro'i snyig khrag rlangs ma yal// kun mkhyen bla mas legs byin pa'i// zab lam bcud 'di'i zur 'debs spro// de la spyi don rnam pa gsum/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjesagasum mo// dang po ma dul gzhi yin na// pa ni blang dang gzung ba gces// rkyang nul khrag chen (15) gyis byugs la// bdud rtsi lnga yi chag chag gdab// srid pa ru log mtshon pa yi// ma traṃ mgo bo lho nub dang*// rkang pa byang shar bstan pa'i steng*// lte ba mthing nag gru+u gsum la// zla gam dmar po gsum dang ldan// de'i phyir rtsibs bzhi rdo rwa dang*/ me ris bskor ba bris pa'i khar// lding khrir dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i// dpal gyi gtor chen 'khor bcu bzhi// mtheb kyu sha dum rgyu ma dang*// mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan pa bkod// mtha' mar ri rgyud 'dre can dang*// phung sa bsres pa'i kong zor ni/ brgya'am bcu gcig (16) grangs ldan la/ brag nag mtsho dang thog lcags phye// dur khrod yungs dkar mi bsad rdo// skyor mda' ltas ngan sgro sdebs la// gri lcags mde'u gnam brtan gzugs// mdor na zor rdzas bye brag rnams// zor gyi gyer bzhin tshogs par bya// hom khung nang du zag rdzas dang*// ldan pa'i liṅga byad du gzhug /kun gyi mtha' mar rgab dkris bya// drag po'i mchod gtor nyer spyod bshams// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum// dang por sngona'agror rnam grangs bcu// thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa ni// tshig bdun gsol 'debs rtsa ba dang*// brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba gdab// gnyis pa dkar gtor btang ba ni// kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung rgyun las/

oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru konya haṃ/ bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo'i (17)skur gyur/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis dkar bgegs gnyis ka brlabs te/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ s+tha na pa ti k+ṣe ṭa pa lañtsa na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs lan gsum/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod (18)sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol la dkar gtor gshegs/ bhu mi pa ti ya hi gats+tsha/ gnyis pa bgegs gtor btang ba ni/ sarba bhu ta ar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ gsum pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ni/ hūm̐ḥhrī: 'khrul pa gzung 'dzin rtog ngan rgyu: rkyen ni chags sdang la sogs pa: lta ba log pa nyon mongs lnga : las kyi 'bras bu (19)smin pa yi: bgegs rigs 'byung por gtogs pa rnams: mchod sbyin gtor ma chen po 'di: mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed: so sor thob pa sngags kyis byas: phyag rgyas pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med: tshig bshad bden pa bkrol te bsngo: sngags 'chang bdag gis bka' ma bcag: gum gum chum cum dam la 'dus: hūm̐: shin tu khro zhing gtum pa la: zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te: khro bor de (20) bzhin gshegs kun mdzad: khro bo'i tshul chen khros pas kyang : 'jig rten gsum dag bsregs byed na: sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yi: khams gsum ma lus dbang sdud na: ma dad sems can smros ci dgos: zhes pa'i bar dang*/ sum bha ni 'i drag sngags thun bcas brdeg par bya/ bzhi pa mtshams gcod srung bakhor ni/ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa las/

hūm̐: bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yi: spyan mig nyi zla 'bar zhing bsreg: thugs las khro bo'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: stong gsum sprul pa'i me yis 'gengs: phyogs (21)mtshams mtshon cha 'chol bas gtams: bdag med stong par mtshams bcad do: oṃ sur+ya tsan+d+ra badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la raṃ raṃ tsakra warti ma hā kro dha sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ e hūm̐ phaṭa: lnga pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin dbang chen khro bo 'chol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dza: hūm̐ hrī: chos sku'i ston pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med: lnga ldan (22)longs sku'i khyab bdag spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje sprul sku'i mnga' bdag pad+ma 'byung : sku gsum rig 'dzin bla ma gro bo lod: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi: bar chad bdud sde'i g.yul las bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum/ drug pa sems bskyed ni/ ho: ma dad gdul bar bya ba'i tshul bstun te: srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud pa dang : ngan song gnas sbyangs ma rig mun khang gtib: thams cad 'jigs shing g.yul du 'brub pa dang : (23)dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku yang bskyed pa'i phyir: bla med byang chub gnas su 'god par bya'o: lan gsum/ bdun pa tshogs gsog ni/ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa las/ ho: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus (24)bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la: dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo:

tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: lan gsum: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ brgyad pa dam bca' bzung ba ni/ ho: ma rig rlabs (25)kyis sems nyid rang zhal bsgrib: ye nas dbyer med rtog pas so sor bzung : rang byung 'du 'bral med pa'i rdo rje sems: sku gsung thugs su bsgrub par dam bca'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho: dgu pa snod bcud byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod: stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub tu: gdug pa'i dam sri btul ba bzhin: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: (26)dur khrod rdzas la brten bcas te: gdung ba drag pos rgyud bskul na: thugs rje chen pos 'dir dgongs shig: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ sa ma ya a we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ: hriṃ hriṃ: sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: bcu pa mchod pa byin brlab ni/ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa las/ hūm̐: dbyings nas yi ge 'bru gsum char du babs: mchod rdzas nyes skyon ma dag bsregs gtor bkrus: bh+rūm̐las rin chen a las bhan+dha'i nang : phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin rgya mtshor (27)gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe: dhu pe: dī paṃ: ghan+dhe: rū pa: shab+da: gan+dhe: ra sa: spar+she sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: sman gtor rak+ta sngags kyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta sa man+ta maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ phaṭa: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yang gnyis// stod las dang ni smad las so// dang por bskyed bzlas yan lag gsum// bskyed par rnam grangs bcu gsum las// de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐ḥ rnam par mi rtog ye (28)nas skye med cing : gzung 'dzin rtog med mtha' gnyis ma chags dbyings:

ye nas mnyam nyid rag bzhin ji bzhin ngang : mtshan ma'i rtog bral smra bsam brjod las 'das: shu n+ya tā dzñā na at+ma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa kun snang ting 'dzin ni/ ma ltar byams pa kun la khyab pa'i sku: mkha' ltar dag pa cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i rgyu: kun la snyom pa'i ye shes gsal ba dang : yon tan rin chen 'byung ba'i dbang ldan yum: dharmā dhartu hūm̐: gsum pa rgyu yi ting 'dzin ni/ (29) yi ge hūm̐ ni sems kyi rang bzhin te: chags pa'i skyon bral pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: sangs rgyas che ba'i khyad par bstan pa'i phyir: rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar khro bo'i sprul pa 'byung : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa rten dang brten bskyed ni/ hūm̐ las zhe sdang 'bar ba'i nam mkha' la: phrag dog g.yo ba'i 'tshub ma rgya gram ldan: chags pa rak+ta'i rba klong (yongs mchan/ )'khyil gtams: gti mug mun pa'i kong rus sa gzhi brdal: nga rgyal chen po'i ri (30)rab me ri 'bar: dbang chen 'byung ba yum lnga'i mkha' la shar: rdo rjai me dpung dur khrod khor yug dbus: bh+rūm̐ las dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal yas khang : phyi ni rin chen nang ni thod pa'i mkhar: khrag zhag 'dam 'thas gnam lcags gzer mas gtams: yid bzhin 'byor ldan rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing : sna tshogs yon tan gsang ba'i mdzod kyi gter: khro bo'i 'byung gnas dpal chen rngam pa'i yul: thug chom 'ur sgra khams (31)gsum yongs su ldir: rgya yongs ma chad tshad med dpag las 'das: tshangs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i gdung khyams la: ti ra pho mo bsnol ba'i dral ma btab: phyogs skyong g.yang gzhi sha chen thogs pa bkram: nya chen 'phan dang sbrul nag za ra tshag: chu srin rus sbal zhing chen smug po'-i sgo: gza' brgyad rgyu skar tshogs kyis kha bad bcas: nyi ma zla ba snang ba'i skar khung brgyan: zhing chen rgyal mtshan zhing (32)chung ba dan phyar: sngon chad 'das pa rgyal sras rnams kyi dbyings: da lta bzhugs pa khro rgyal rol pa'i gnas:

slad nas 'byon pa'i rgyal sras gshegs pa'i shul: dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i pho brang dbus: thod rus bar khyams gru chad dpag pa laḥ gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzer mgo gtams: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi lte ba chos 'byung dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i dbus: bdud dang dam sri byi chung bsnol ba'i steng : dmu (33)stag mi zan shin tu rngam pa'i tshul: zhe sdang rgyas pa'i mche ba sder mo gzing : 'dod chags 'khrugs pa' m-ig rtsa khrag tu khol: nga rgyal khengs pa hūm̐ gi nga ro sgrogs: dbang gi phrin las mgyogs pa'i mthu dang ldan: shes rab rtsal gyis ye shes pha rol phyin: rig pa'i rlabs kyis sa gsum cig char gnon: mkha' lding rgyal po gzan la bab pa'i tshul: rang rig gsal ba rgyu yi yi ge nyid: gdan la (34)bab cing byang chub sems sprin las: sprul pa bsam mi khyab cing yongs gyur pas: thig le dmar po 'bar zhing 'phro bar gyur: stong pa'i dbyings las thus rjes glus bskus te: e ma sems na sangs rgyas tshogs can rnams: ma dad 'khrul pa'i log rtog sems can rnams: sngon gyi las nyon sa bonartsub mos 'phang : 'bras bu nyon mongs lnga ru smin pa rnams: gdul bya 'dul phyir khro bo 'chol bar bzheng : bskul ba gsan nas (35)sku gsum thugs rje g.yos: srid gsum zla med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: 'chi med rdo rje phyag rgya chen po brnyes: dbang drag khros pa rdo rje gro bo lod: sku mdog mthing nag stong zil chag pa'i mdangs: baiḍūr sngon po nyi ma bye bas brgyan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis sag lham gsol: 'dor stabs stag mo'i mgo dang 'phong rting brdzis: sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung rgod gshed drag shul 'bar: snying rje rngam dang zhi (36)ba gar dgu rdzogs: dmar smug ber phyams chos gos gsum gyis spras: kha dog me 'bar bye ru'i 'od 'khyil bas: sa gsum zil gnon srid gsum gzhob tu bsregs:

ral pa khams nag rdo rje'i tshol bu 'khyil: me rlung 'khrigs pas zhe sdang gdug pa'i tshogs: khro bo dbang sdud 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra rngams: spyan mig me 'bar stong gsum nyi zla 'khrugs: smin ma glog 'gyu dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: snyan (37)cha dung long rdo rje'i khong gseng nas: 'brug gi sgra sgrogs rdo rje'i thog char 'bebs: shangs kyi klong nas mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub: rgyud lnga sgrol ba'i hom zhal aṃ gtsigs bsdam: mche ba rab gcig ljags las 'od zer 'phro: ag tshom sma ra gdug pa'i me dpung 'bar: log 'dren bdud dang mu stegs thal bar brlag: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtsai lnga phyar: ra las skyes pa'i gnam lcags ral gri (38)'bar: rdo rje'i tshwa tshab ban dgra glang snying 'gems: phyag g.yon sku gsum lhun grub lcags phur 'dril: zhe sdang las skyes rgyal 'gong dam sri rnams: dpa' skong zil gnon mya ngan bskyed par byed: lcags sdig nag po ser chen bzhin du 'bebs: thugs kar rin chen zla gam dmar po'i dbus: dpal chen rta mchog pad+ma he ru ka: dmar gsal 'khrugs pa dus mtha'i me bzhin 'bar: dbu lnga bcu drug phyag la zhabs brgyad bsgrad: (39)rdo rje'i khyung gshog bya khyung nyi zlas mtshan: dur khrod dpal gyi chas rnams sku la rdzogs: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhir gzigs pa'i dbu: steng zhal kun kyang las bzhi'i rta mgo mtsher: dri za gshin rje klu yi dbang po dang : gnod sbyin bdud kyi tshogs la mya ngan bskyed: g.yas brgyad rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ dril bu dang : lcags kyu sbrul zhags 'khor lo ral gri zhags: g.yon brgyad thod khrag pad+ma ru tra'i snying : rdo rje'i (40)dbyug pa rgya gram be con me: tri shu la dang ye shes khyung khra 'gyed: yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan baiḍūr mdog: phyag gnyis nor bu rin chen za ma tog: bsnams shing yab yum bde ba chen por sbyor:

༈ de yi thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad dbus: gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba la: pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: rang byung rig pa hūm̐ yig dmar po'i mthar: rtsa ba'i rig sngags bye ru'i phreng ba bzhin: oṃ pad+man+ta krita h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: (41)oṃ badz+ra shrī gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ 'od zer lcags kyi tshwa tsha gtam pa'am: mgal me dmar po klad la bskor ba bzhin: 'khor zhing snang bas bde gshegs zhing khams 'geng : sgra dang 'od kyis rgyud bskul mchod sprin spros: slar yang ngan song gnas sbyangs rgyud lnga bsgral: kun kyang dpal chen khro bo'i zhing du bsgyur: gzung 'dzin rtog bral byang chub sems kyi ngang : gdan gsum yongs rdzogs chos sku'i rol par blta: (42) ༈ gtso bo'i spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : rdo rje slob dpon bhud+dha thod phreng rtsal: dmar smug brjid pa zhi khro'i nyams kyis sgeg: sngags kyi phod chen mthing nag sku la gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs dar mthing cod pan 'phur: sna tshogs dar dang rin po che yis brgyan: g.yas pa ḍa ru g.yon pa 'khor lo 'dzin: mi g.yo mnyam pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs steng pad+ma nyi zla'i dbus: rdo rje rin (43)chen pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: karma thod phreng dkar ser dmar ljang mdog: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma'i mchod sdong dang : phrin las lhun grub sna tshogs rgya gram g.yon: kun kyang g.yas pa'i thod pa'i ḍa ru 'khrol: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo'i tshul dang mtshungs: gru chad bzhi la pad+ma bam gyi steng : rigs bzhi'i ging chen dkar ser dmar ljang mdog: g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon pas bhan+dha thogs: gsang ba'i yum bzhi gri gug thod pa 'dzin: (44)kun kyang gcer bu rin chen rus pa'i brgyan: zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs gar gyi rol par 'gying : bar khyams gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' gro ma: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa:

sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges cir yang 'char: pho brang sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa dang : rdo rje'i lcags sgrog rdo rje'i dril bu ma: phrin las bzhi sgrub rgyal chen pho nyar 'gyed: snang stong ma 'gags 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin: gdod nas lhun grub (45)dkyil 'khor chen por shar:

lnga pa byin rlabs dbang bskur ni/ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa las/ hūm̐: rang las shar ba'i dpal chen tshogs: mthu rtsal yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir: sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs cing : ye shes lnga ru dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhūm̐ swā oṃ āḥ rang gi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ: mgrin par pad+ma la āḥ rang gi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ: mgrin par pad+ma la ā: snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs: yi ge gsum la thim: (46)de yongs su gyur pa las: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam pa nyi shu byang chub pa'i lha: spyi bor rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa: mgrin par snang mtha' dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa: thugs kar mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pas rgyas btab pas gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs par gyur: rdo rje rtse lnga gsum pa dang*// gcig pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum btug oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā ka ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā ko3 haṃ: de bzhin (47)wā ka dang*/ tsit+ta sbyar/ slar yang spyi bo'i gnas so sor// rigs lnga'i dbang rgya bca' bzhin du/ oṃ ma hā pra t+ya be k+ṣa ṇa dzñā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+mā ko3 haṃ: de bzhin du/ oṃ ma hā a dar+sha: oṃ ma hā sa man+ta: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta: oṃ ma hā kri t+yā nuṣ+ṭha na dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā ko3 haṃ: spyi bo'i gnas lngar dbang lha yab yum rjes chags rgyas pa'i zhu bde'i chu rgyun byang chub sems kyi rol pas dbang bskur: nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma sbyangs: phung po lnga rigs lnga'i (48)sangs rgyas su gnas 'gyur bas kun brtags la gzhan dbang gis rgyas btab: chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las: gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyis rgyas thebs shing ye shes 'gyur ba med pa'i brdar dbu gtsug na rdo rje phyed pa dang :

rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: rang gi 'dun pa sems pa dang : snying ga'i 'od kyi rol pa chen pos phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi (49)'khor lor badz+ra sa mā dza: snyan mna'/ drug pa spyan 'dren ni/ spos dang rol mo dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: gling g-i ming ni 'dzam bu'i gling : (40)gnas kyi mchog gyur o rgyan gnas: yul gyi ming ni li yi yul: rang byung mchod rten 'jig rten brtsegs: slob dpon rdo rje gro bo lod: dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes: 'khor du karma mkha' 'gros bskor: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol: gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi (51)hūm̐: bdun pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bde chen chos sku brdal ba'i zhing khams su: ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga'i pho brang dbus: gdul thabs sgyu mar rol pa'i gdan khri la: ye nas gnyis med lhun grub chen por bzhugs: chos dbyings dag pa dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: ye shes khyad par 'phags pa'i gzhal yas su: dpal chen rdo rje gro lod lha tshogs rnams: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: (52)sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya s+t+wam: pra we sha ya phaṭa: a we sha ya āḥ brgyad pa phyag gi mchod pa ni/ 'dod chags dag pas shes rab pha rol phyin: ma 'gags rol pa'i phyag rgya cir yang snang : bde gshegs yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal lo: nyon mongs rtog pa'i drwa ba kun bcom nas:

ye shes dgu yi don dang rab ldan pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu hoḥ pra tī ts+tsha ho: shraṃ na ma: dgu pa kun bzang bzhi (53) bsnol mchod/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung chen por shar: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing khams rgyas par 'geng : sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab maḥ mchod chen dbang gi tshul du 'bul lags na: dam tshig dgyes pa mchog la rol mdzod cig: na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: puṣ+pe (54)dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā: bcu pa 'dod yon drug gis mchod/ ( pa ni/) 'dod yon rang 'phrul rdo rje'i dam tshig ste: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos kyi khams: rdo rje lha mo gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa rnams bzhes: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa par+she dharma ho: bcu gcig khyad par mchog gis mchod/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa chen po 'di: 'dod pa'i yon tan lha mor byin (55)rlabs shing : pad+ma rak+ta pañtsa a mṛ ta: dam tshig bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol: ha he pra we sha yak+sha rak+sha sa ma ya a ra li khā hi: bcu gnyis yon tan rjes dran bstod/ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni (56)mi 'gags mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung : thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma rgyal la bstod: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten mnga' bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje gro lod rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod:

dbang drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: khro bo'i rgyal po za byed hūm̐ sgra can: rta skad rngam pa dngos grub (57)gter gyi mdzod: dbang mchog 'baraba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: thams cad lhun grub bhud+dha thod phreng rtsal: phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal bstod: sna tshogs gar bsgyur thogs med phrin las bdag: (58)rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bstod: tshogs chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor sgo skyong zhing : tshad med bzhi ldan phrin las bzhi sgrub cing : gdug pa'i 'khor ba ling la 'debs mkhas shing : dpal gyi bka' nyan skyong ma bzhi la bstod: bcu gsum dam tshig nyams chags bshags/ bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar zhing gzir: ma rig dbang gis smin po rgyud lngar 'khyams: log rtog ngan pa'i dbang bsgyur 'gal(59)'khrul rnams: ye shes gzigs mnga' 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya brjod/ bskyed pa lha yi rnal 'byor ro/ gnyis par rnam grangs bcu gcig las/ dang po bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ phaṭa dza: sa bdag mdun so sor dbye/ bdag mdun thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad dbus: gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba la: pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: rang byung rig pa hūm̐ yig dmar po'i mthar: rtsa ba'i rig sngags bye ru'i phreng ba bzhin:(60) gnyis pa rta mchog rol pa'i sngags/ oṃ pad+man+ta krita h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: bsnyen sngags 'bum phrag bzhi ru bzla/ gsum pa rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra shrī gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: sgrub sngags grangs bsnyen 'bru 'bum la/ mtshan ma rtags mthong dus zla drug bzhi pa spro bsdu'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'od zer lcags kyi tshwa tshwa gtam pa'am: 'gal me dmar po klad la bskor ba bzhin:

'khor zhing snang bas bde gshegs zhing khams 'gengs: sgra dang 'od kyis rgyud bskul mchod sprin spros: slar yang ngan song gnas sbyangs rgyud lnga (61)bsgral: kun kyang dpal chen khro bo'i zhing du gyur: gzung 'dzin rtog bral byang chub sems kyi ngang : gdan gsum yongs rdzogs chos sku'i rol par blta: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes bzla 'od gsal dgongs sa bskyangs/ / lnga sa srung ba'i rdzogs chen bca'// rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog las/ gtso bo'i thugs srog gi klad kor du bla ma ha'i khog par bsrung bya: zhabs kyur yul mkhar nor phyugs gsal ba: thugs srog las 'od zer 'phros: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs (62)rgyud bskul: mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan 'od zer ser po'i rnam par bsdus pa gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i ngo bo nyid rdo rje'i rdul phra rab tu gur pas srung byed rdo rje'i gur la thim pas rdo rje'i bzhu blugs su gyur pas cis kyang mi tshugs par bsgom la/ oṃ badz+ra shrī gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa badz+ra tsakra warti bh+rum̐ sarba lo ki swā hā: zhes pa stong phrag tsam du bzla// drug pa bzlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor gshom// yum ka'i seng gdong bdud bzlog gi /byad ma stobs 'joms dmigs pa ni/ (63)hūm̐ srung 'khor gsal brtan 'bar ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros pas: stong gsum 'jig rten hūm̐ gis gang : byad gdon stongs shing zad par bsgral: slar 'dus rdo rje rwa ba'i phyir: ye shes me dang gnyis med klong : yongs gyur gnam lcags 'khor lo ni: rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i rno dbal la: byad phur rbod gtong sri keg dang : gnod byed dgra gdon log 'dren tshogs: so so'igazugs dang byad (64)dbyibs ltar: rang dbang med par bkug byas nas: spu gri reg gcod 'thor rlung gis: 'khor lo g.yon du bskor ba yis:

gzugs phung thal ba'i rdul du brlag: sngags phreng las byung me stag gis: lhag ma rjes shul med par bsregs: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su phaṭa: rtsa sngags sham du/ oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan: sa ga pa sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsir tsar tsir tsar: baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu: rbad tra ko sha ya (65)rbad tra ko sha ya: ho ra ho ra: ci du sod ci du sod: shig lhu ru gtub: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba dul: gnod byed che ge mo ka wa tsi brlag brlag: trig nan myag thuṃ ha na da ha pa tsa mug mug thib thib hed hed bh+yo bzlog phaṭa: zhes bzlas bden stobs brjod pa ni/ / yum ka'i seng gdong srung bzlog las/ sangs rgyas kyis ni bdud pham mdzad: chos ma yin pa chos kyis so: dge 'dun gyis ni mu stegs pham: dbang pos lha min pham par gyur: lha min (66)rnams kyis zla ba pham: nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho yi: klu rnams rab tu pham par gyur: me yis bud shing bsreg pa dang : rlung gis sprin rnams gtor ba dang : rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang : lha rnams bden pa rab tu gnas: bden pa 'di dag thams cad kyis: daing 'dir bden pa 'grub gyur cig: zhes brjod thal brdeb lan gsum bya// bdun pa bsad pa'i thog chen 'bebs/ gzhung las/ rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa ban dgra glang snying 'gem: zhes dang*/ lcags sdigs nag po ser (67)chen bzhin du 'bebs: zhes pa'i dgongs pa gsal 'debs ni/ sku dang phyag mtshan thams cad las// gnam lcags rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa dang*// lcags ldig nag po ser chen bzhin 'bebs pas stong khams thams cad khengs/ yum ka'i seng gdong gtor bzlog las/ pha rol byad phur dmag tshogs dang*// sde brgyad log 'dren thal bar brlag /'khor 'das byang chub sems kyi klong : gnyis snang dgra 'dre dbyings su yal: rtsa sngags sham du/ oṃ badz+ra rak+sha ra tsa'i tsit+ta zung : kha rag sme (68)sha rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta rbad: 'khu na dum bu rā tsa'i tsit+ta shig:

'da' na rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta phyung : ldog na rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta rbad: tri'u gtub gtub rbad rbad: tsit+ta hu lu hu lu rbad: tsit+ta rak+sha gtub gtub: tri'u du tri'u du: badz+ra sarba du ṣ+ṭaṃ trig nan: hur thuṃ dza mā ra ya rbad: ces pa'i las sngags khri khrag gcig /thun rdzas la yang sngags kyis btab// brgyad pa sngags kyi nus pa gso// dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams// lan gsum dgu pa mchod sprin spro// mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mangs sam// las byang gzhung las (69) 'byung bas mchod// bcu pa bstod pa phrin las ltar// bcu gcig yig brgya nongs pa 'chags// bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro// gsum pa bsod nams spel la brgyad// dang po rgyab dpung bskyed pa'i phyir// bka' srung bka' gter srung ma'i phrin las btang*/ gnyis pa tshogs rdzas sbyang rtogs sbar/ bkra shis mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen lnga: phyi nang gsang ba sgrub pa'i dam tshig rdzas: gzhan yang 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa rnams: rnam dag byang chub yi ge gsum gyis sbyong : sku gsung (70)thugs kyi dngos grub bsdus pa'i dbyig: zag med kun bzang sprin gyi rol par bsgyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum pa tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa/ oṃ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: bsod nams can du deng bdag gyur: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: yid bzhin mchod pa dam pa bzhes su gsol: shrī badz+ra aṅku sha dza: shrī badz+ra pa sha hūm̐: shrī badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: shrī badz+ra ghan+de ho: bzhi pa yul bzhi'i lha mos mchod/ ho: dung mdog (71)sgeg mo rdo rje'i spyan: sems dpa' sngon po ye shes 'bebs: me long lta bu'i ye shes la: badz+ra la bo'i mchod pa rol: yid bzhin rin chen 'od 'bar ma: 'jam dpal rnon po'i dngos grub 'dzin: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la: badz+ra ma le'i mchod pa rol:

pad+ma dbyangs mkhan rma bya'i mgrin: spyan ras gzigs kyi dngos grub 'dzin: so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes la: badz+ra ghirti'i mchod pa rol: gar lakhan (72)'gying ba gzi ldan ma: las kyi 'khor lo rnam par 'joms: bya ba nan tan ye shes la: badz+ra nirti'i mchod pa rol: nang gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: shrī badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐: shrī badz+ra ma le traṃ: shrī badz+ra ghirti hrī: shrī badz+ra nirti ā: lnga pa dus bzhi'i lha mos mchod/ spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bdug pas 'gengs: byams pa thabs dang (73)shes rab las: badz+ra dhu pe'i mchod pa rol: ut+pal mthing nag me tog 'thor: zla gam rin chen 'phro 'du gsal: snying rje thabs dang shes rab las: badz+ra puṣ+pe'i mchod pa rol: dbang gi phyag na sgron me bsnams: chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'bar ba 'dzin: dga' ba thabs dang shes rab las: badz+ra ā lo ke'i mchod pa rol: tsan+da (tsan+dan )bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma: dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thig le 'bebs: btang snyoms thabs dang shes rab (74)las: badz+ra ghan+dhe'i mchod pa rol: phyi yi mchod pa dam pa 'di: tshad med bzhi dag mnyam par sbyor: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: shrī badz+ra dhu pe dhu: shrī badz+ra puṣ+pe pu: shrī badz+ra ā lo ke hrī: shrī badz+ra ghan+dhe gan:

drug pa 'dod yon lnga yis mchod/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad kun: sna tshogs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi: chos dbyings dag pa'i ye shes te: rdo rje lha mo gzugs mdzes ma: 'dod yon phyag na bsnams nas ni: rkang pas gar byed lag (75)stabs bsgyur: snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs nas ni: dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul: thams cad ma lus sgra rnams ni: grags stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi: me long lta bu'i ye shes te: rdo rje lha mo 'jam pa'i sgra: 'dod yon phyag na bsnams nas ni: rkang pas gar byed lag stabs bsgyur: snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs nas ni: dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul: bde ba tshim byed bsod nams mchog: tshim byed ngo bo (76)nyid kyi gzi: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes te: rdo rje lha mo dri mchog ma: 'dod yon phyag na bsnams nas ni: rkang pas gar byed lag stabs bsgyur: snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs nas ni: dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul: bde ba'i ro yi tshim byed ma: tshim stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te: rdo rje lha mo bde ba mo: 'dod yon phyag na bsnams nas ni: rkang pas gar byed lag stabs bsgyur: snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs nas (77)ni: dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul: bde mchog dkyil 'khor yangs byed ma: rdo rje lha mo reg bya ste: 'dod yon phyag na bsnams nas ni: rkag pas gar byed lag stabs bsgyur: snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs nas ni: dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul: thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur cig: byang chub sems dang ma chags pa'i: gnyis su med par tshim gyur nas: tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par (78)ldan: shrī badz+ra rū pa oṃ: shrī badz+ra shab+da hūm̐: shrī badz+ra gan+dhe trām̐: shrī badz+ra rā sa hrī: shrī badz+ra par+she āḥ bdun pa tshogs phud dang po ni/ tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal dang ldan: tshogs kyi slob dpon gshegs su gsol: gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro:

reg bya chos la sogs pa yi: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'di: bde bar gshegs la 'bul lags na: dgyes pa'i don la bzhes su gsol: mnyam nyid bde ba'i mchod pa niḥ chos kyi dbyings su ro (79)gcig pas: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis: lha rnams mnyes shing dngos grub 'bebs: brgyad pa bar pa bshags pa ni/ ho dbang chen rdo rje gro lod dgongs su gsol: ma rig rmongs pas ldong ba'i skye 'gro dang : rnal 'byor dam la gnas pa'i sgrub pa po: thog ma med pa'i dus nas da bar 'khor: gzung 'dzin chags pa'i dbang gis bsags pa yi: rgyud drug bag chags ji snyed ma lus dang : rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams (80)pa rnams: rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: yig brgya brjod/ stong las rnal 'byor sgrub pa'o/ gnyis pa mngon spyod las sbyor la// bco lnga'i dang po thugs dam bskul/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku: 'od dpag med mgon ston pa gangs chen mtsho: rigs lnga rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs: dgongs pa gcig bsdus dbang chen khros pa dgongs: log gcod gdug pas kheng ba'i ru tra (81)des: sbyor ba rtsub mos 'jig rten nyam thag tshe: khro la khros pa rol pa'i phrin las kyis: dkyil 'khor thams cad bdag la bsdu mdzad de: stong nyid snying rje khros pa'i nga rgyal gyis: 'dzin rtog log pa'i bdag po 'dul ba bzhin: thugs dam bskul ba drag po'i sngags la dgongs: o ru lu ru lu hūm̐: byang chub sems kyis gzi brjid ldan byas nas: 'phro 'du 'od kyis 'khor ba ru bzlog cing : rdo rje slob dpon thod phreng (82)rigs lnga'i tshogs: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ra mda' gnyer: sprul pa bsam mi khyab cing bsgyur la rngams: khams gsum dregs pa'i tshogs la skyabs ling thob: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang :

sprul sku rigs kyi sprul pa brjod mi longs: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐: gnyis pa(83)lha srung skyems kyis brngan: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas rjes// yig rnying zhal bsgyur gnang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ khyad par dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed// ma mgon lcam dral tshe ring mched lnga dang*// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum bcu yab yum sras// bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag (84)gzhug bcas pa rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpu+ung bskyed// sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang*// sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed/ gsum pa bden rdzun drang shan 'byed/ hūm̐ bh+yo: ma nyes ma len 'phags pa'i tshogs: bde gshegs rnams kyis gzu dpang mdzod: zhal lce lha 'dre yongs kyis chod: dgongs (85)shig dus gsum bde gshegs dang : sras bcas dkon mchog gsum po dgongs: bstan pa gshigs pa'i dam nyams la: bsrung skyob mgon grogs ma mdzad cig: bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas la: ldang ba'i sems dang rtsub pa'i sems: gdug pa'i sems dang mi mthun sems: gnod pa'i sbyor ba shom pa dang : 'bem bca' sngags dang 'khrul 'khor bskor: phra men ngan sngags rbad pa yi: ban dgra blang snying (86)bsam ngan dang : mi dang mi min thams cad kyi: stobs dang nus pa thams cad bshigs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad 'phrog: sha zo khrag 'thung khram la tob: smyo 'bog myos dang brgyal du chug:

rang mtshon nus pa rang gshed phob: drang srong dmod pa'i bka' chad thong : bzhi pa dmigs rten 'bem du bzung*/ e raṃ phaṭa raṃ dz+wa la raṃ: e ngo mtshar bsad pa'i da la ni: phyi ni gru bzhi gdengs pa la: nang ni zla gam 'bar ba yi: lte ba e rdzong (87)dmar nag 'bar: dug gsum rang mtshon btson khang du: dkon mchog slob dpon sku dgra dang : rnal 'byor bdag la sgos kyi dgra: dam log dam tshig ldan pa'i dgra: 'du bar yongs dang sems can 'tsho: rang rgyud smin pa zhing bcu'i dgra: bdag la do bsdo phod btsug zhing : bsam ngan phra men las sbyor brtsams: ban dgra glang snying byad ma rnams: phung khams skye mched tshang ba'i gzugs: mi sdug nyam (88) thag gzas po gsal: lnga pa bden pas dgugs pa ni/ o rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i gsung*/ na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang : chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang : khyad par du che mchog pad+ma drag po dbang (89)chen rdo rje gro bo lod kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas: bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra: khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ snga dgra lag gis brdar ba: phyi dgra yid la bsam pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can ldang ba'i dgra dang : gzugs med (90)gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig

rtsa sngags mthar/ nri tri badz+ra aṅku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: lan gsum/ drug pa pho nya spro/ hūm̐ dza: stobs bcu mnga' ba rdo rje gro bo lod: dbang chen gar gyi dbang phyug sras dang 'khor: sangs rgyas chos dang phags pa'i tshogs chen po: mchog gsum bden pa dmod pa'i pa'i byin rlabs dang : snying (91)po sngags rgya ting 'dzin bden pa'i mthus: gang la bya ba'i dam nyams sdig chen rnams: lcags kyus bzung la zhags pas ske nas 'ching : yan lag sdom la dril bus myos byas nas: dmigs rten mtshan ma'i rdzas la gnyis med khug: rtsa sngags/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nṛ tri aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ bla sha re ma ti 'grim sogs/ bdun pa skyob byed lha dang dbye/ bh+yo: las byed phra men phra ma mkhan: gang la bya ba'i skyob pa'i lha: mi dang lha gnyis (92)dbyen gyis phyes: mkhon chug rang gshed rang la phob: ru tra hab le hob le shag phyes: ru tra ma ni ma mas shag phyes: ma trag rak+ṣa shag phyes: dhai wa ni ma ra ya shag phyes: de wa san+t+ri shag phyes: dhe ba shag phyes: bha ri shag phyes: tsit+ta shag phyes: na su ye shag phyes: na ga phus pa shag phyes: ka kha ga gha nga shag phyes: gha dzha ḍha dha bha yaṃ shag phyes: bdun pa drang srong dmod pas bsgral / hūm̐: dpal (93) chen gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed na: stobs chen khro bo thugs khros nas: rdo rje me yi ser ba dang : drag po sngags kyis sgra chen pos: brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za: dgra bgegs srog rtsa len par byed: lok+t+ri'i sngags mthar/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di yi srid pa spyi nas shig cig: srid gsum rmang nas sgyel cig: 'khor ba gting nas phyung zhig: bskal pa'i mes sregs shig: bka' (94)yi dmod pas sdig shig bka' yi chad pa chod cig: gnam lcags ral gris spyi gtsug nas rgyob cig: mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru thong zhig: snying dum bu stong du thong zhig:

lus dum bu stong du gtub cig: rdo rje'i ser ba chen po phob cig: dgra bo mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa phung du chug cig ya: ho: dpal chen po rdo rje gro bo lod kyi lha tshogs las byed bka' yi pho nya rnams kyis sdig can 'di'i bla dang rdzu 'phrul (95)'phrol cig: khong nas snying phyung zhig: kha nas khrag skyug cig: gnam gyi 'ju thag chod cig: sa yi rten phur phud cig: bar gyi dmu thag chod cig: ltag nas bdud g.yos cig: mdun nas 'od 'phrog cig: nye 'brel mi nor dang phrol cig: gong gi phu bo dang phrol cig: 'og gi nu bo dang phrol cig: mchan gyi bu dang phrol cig: glo bur dang ye 'grog thong zhig: mi nad dang phyugs nad (96) thong zhig: glad khrag dang snying khrag dkrugs shig: mda' gri dang mdung grir sod cig: dme gro chu gri rbab grir sod cig: 'gag gri lceb grir sod cig: lo nad zla gcong gis sod cig: mdze dang rims nad kyis sod cig: rang srog rang gis chod cig: ya thod nyi ma 'od ru chug cig: ma thod sa rdo 'gal du chug cig: phung gsum g.yab mo thob la dregs pa'i 'dre dmag thong cig: bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las (97)mdzod cig: rtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta zung : kha rag sme sha rak+sha rā tsa'i tsirta rbad: 'khu na dum bu ra tsa'i tsit+ta shig: 'da' na rak+sha ra tsa'i tsit+ta phyung : ldog na rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta rbad: tri'u gtub gtub rbad rbad: tsit+ta hu lu hu lu rbad: tsit+ta rak+sha gtub gtub: tri'u dutri'u du: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ trig nan: hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: ces pas thun rdzas sna tshogs dbab/ khyad par phur bu snying gar gzir// gzas po'i bla tshe 'od dkar po// (98)phur rtses blangs te rang la bstim// phur pa las byung ye shes mes// rigs drug sa bon bsregs shing sbyangs// rnam shes a yig he ru ka'i// thugs kyi klong du spar ba ste// dgongs pa gsum gyis gdab par bya// snyigs ma ral gris dum bur gtub// brgyad pa zhal du bstab pa ni/

hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen rta mgrin rdo rje gro bo lod: sras dang sprul pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: gnam sa gdangs pa tsam gyis zhal phyes cig: gangs ri 'bar ba tsam gyis mche ba gtsigs: nyi zla 'bar ba tsam gyis spyan (99)mig bzlog: glog dmar 'khyug pa tsam gyis ljags rkyongs shig: bstabs so gdug can bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: bzhes shig bzhes shig lhag med rol mdzod cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hī: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā zhing chen la khā hiḥ dgu pa thugs dam bskang ba ni// skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu btang*// bcu pa tshogs la rol ba ni/ ho: tshogs (100)kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la ho: zhes drangs bsam pa lhun grub rjes/ dpa' bo las rab rtsal gyis gsungs/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng gis// bdag sogs rjes gzung tshe rab thams cad du// 'gal rkyen kun zhi bsam don lhun grub nas// mthar thug pad+ma 'od du skye bar shog / bcu gcig lhag ma btang ba ni/ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa las/ kyai: dang po phud kyis mi mchod du: dpal chen dkyil 'khor tshogs kyi bdag: bar du bshags pa mi bgyi ru: rnal 'byor ldan la dam tshig gnyan: tha ma bsgral (101)bstab mi bgyi ru: rtogs pas bdag rgyud sngon bsgral phyir: da lta lhag mas mi mchod du: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging laṅga: pho nya sum brgya drug cu sogs: kun kyang dpal chen sprul pa yin: lhag ma kha chus mi bran du: dam tshig gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir: 'bangs thog rje yis mi mnan du: ci bcol las la bskul ba'i phyir: rje la 'bangs kyis mi rgol du: drag shul las thabs myur (102)ba'i phyir: he ru ka'i dam rgyas kha bru+u dbab// o rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i gsungs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ

lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: e a ral+li pheṃ pheṃ dza: badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa las/ hūm̐ḥ rnam dag rang bzhin zhi ba las: bcom ldan dpal chen sprul pa ni: thabs shes zla gsang rol pa las: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba ste: khyed cag sngon gyi yal gam can: lag na glo snying nang khrol (103)thog: legs nyes stang 'dzin tshogs khang nyul: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med: sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i tshe: khas blangs dam bca' dran gyis la: srin mo'i za lam chen po ru: pham phab long la bstan pa srungs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: bcu gnyis bzlog pa'i phrin las la/ ling ro gtor chung sman raka sgran/ hūm̐ bh+yo: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i zhing khams nas: rigs (104)brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: mtshan mchog brgyad dang rnal 'phrul dpag tu med: zhi dang khro bo'i rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab: lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gro bo lod: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur zhing bstabs lags na: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang : maṃ sa king rus sha khrag gtor ma 'bul: dug gsum gtams pa'i mchod pas thugs (105)dam bskang : rmad du byung ba gtor mas thugs dam bskang : rak+ta chags pa dmar gyis thugs dam bskang : gzugs dang gzugs med tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : dam rdzas bdud rtsi phud kyis thugs dam bskang : bya nag lug nag mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang bas thams cad bzlog tu gsol: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: ma rig gzung 'dzin ( 106)'khrul pa'i sems kyis brlabs: dug lnga rang rgyud smin pa'i dgra dang bgegs: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug rnams: bzlog bsgyur drag po sngags kyi g.yul ngo bshams:

rgyab brten dpung du dkon mchog gsum po bzhengs: drang srong dmod pa'i sngags kyi mtshon cha gdeng : ma rungs zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig pa can: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i tshogs la lings su 'debs: gang la bya ba'i thal ba'i rdul du rlog: nyes (107)med rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa la: gdug pa hom la sbyin bsregs btab pa dang : 'byung ba'i dgra gshed pa la gshor du mnan: chu la gtad dang rlung la zor du bskur: sngags kyi gshed bskor dbye bskrad rig sngags sbyor: glang snying byad ma kla klo gdug pa'i dpung : bzlog sgyur drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: slar la rang gshed rang gi bdud du phob: dus mtha' bstung zhing brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod:

rtsa sngags dang lok+t+ri'i gsham/ (108)trig nan myag thuṃ ha na da ha pa tsa mug mug thib thib hed hed bh+yo bzlog phaṭa: hūm̐ bh+yo:////// thugs kar zla gam gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: gar gyi dbang phyug rta mchog he ru ka: pad+ma gzi ldan rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum: sras dang sprul pa bsam mi khyab pa'i tshogs: ma dad sems can chen po sogs 'dres so// sogs kyi 'gres byang dang po gnyis// gzhung ltar sbyar nas gsum pa las/ hūm̐ bh+yo: chos dbyings ye shes rnam snang gangs chen mtsho: rdo rje slob dpon (109)bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: zhes sogs 'gres byang gong bzhin sbyar/ hūm̐ bh+yo: me long ye shes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs dang*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: mnyam nyid ye shes rat+na thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs dang*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: sor rtog ye shes pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs dang*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bya grub ye (110)shes karma thod phreng rtsal: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs dang*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: sogs dang*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: phrin las bzhi sgrub dbang phyug sgo ma'i tshogs: ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas: zhes sogs sbyar ba'i 'gres dgu ma// lan gcig song rjes 'gres gsum ma// gzhung ltar tshar grangs bsags pa'i mthar// bcu gsum zlog 'phyang gyer ba ni// rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog las/ hūm̐: zlog byed dbang drag rol pa'i lha: (111) bzlog bsgyur las mdzad dus la bab: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: sngon las 'phral rkyen bar chad bgegs: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sogs: bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po dang : phyi nang drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon:

ban bon mu stegs rig sngags byad: gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i khram: phur pa'i dbal kha bon po'i gtso: kla klo'i g.yul dang ngan sngags sbyor: lha srin khros dang (112)gdon chen zug: sdeb gshor hom dang thun zor mnan: gtad khram rbod gtong rbad 'dre dang : mi kha gleng gzhi 'thab rtsod mchu: keg sri than ltas ngan pa kun: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo dang : yongs la gnod pa'i bgegs gdon sogs: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i steng du bh+yo: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: bsgyur ro za kha dgra la bsgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bcu bzhi bzlog sngags gong bzhin dang*// bden stobs bcas pa'i thal (113) mo rdeb// bco lnga thun gtor la dmigs te// 'gug bzhug rjes su byin brlab ni/ dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ngo bo rang bzhin rnam par dag cing rmad du byung ba las rnam pa dgra bo'i sha khrag gi rang bzhin yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs dang srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i dgyes skong dam par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: e a ra li hriṃ hring dzaḥdzaḥ gsum gyis brlab/ zhes sogs mnan pa'i gzhung ltar rjes// rtsa sngags gtor sngags btags pas 'bul// de nyid zor du bskul ba ni/ (114)dzaḥbh+yo rbad: bh+yo: do nub drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs pa: drang srong dmod pa'i dmar gyi gtor ma 'di: gang la bya ba'i zhing bcu'i steng du 'phen/ bzlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: lok+t+ri'i sngags gsham/ zor ma ra ya zor ya: e sa bh+yo bzlog rbad ya: gsum pa rgyun gyi rjes chog la// rnam grangs bcu gsum pa'i dang po// chos skyong rgyun gtor spyi ltar bskyangs// gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku: 'od dpag med mgon ston pa (115)gangs chen mtsho: rigs lnga rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs:

dgongs pa gcig bsdus dbang chen khros pa dgongs: log spyod gdug pas kheng ba'i ru tra des: sbyor ba rtsub mos 'jig rten nyam thag tshe: khro la khros pa rol pa'i phrin las kyis: dkyil 'khor thams cad bdag la bsdu mdzad do: stong nyid snying rje khros pa'i nga rgyal gyis: 'dzin rtog log pa'i bdag po 'dul ba bzhin: thugs dam (116)bskul ba drag po'i sngags la dgongs: oṃ ru lu ru lu hū: byang chub sems kyi gzi brjid ldan byas nas: 'phro 'du 'od kyi 'khor ba ru bzlog cing : rdo rje slob dpon thod phreng rigs lnga'i tshogs: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ra mda' gnyer: sprul pa bsam mi khyab cing bsgyur ma rngams: khams gsum dregs pa'i tshogs la skyabs ling : oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : sprul sku rigs kyi (117)sprul pa brjod mi longs: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐: zhes sogs gzhung las 'byung ba dang*// gsum pa chad tho bsgrags pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen rta mgrin rdo rje gro bo lod: khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i tshogs kyis gar bsgyur zhing : ma rung dregs pa'i sde dpon 'dul ba'i tshe:(118)dam la btags pa'i dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging : ma sring 'bar ma pho nya las mkhan rnams: dam rdzas dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma longs: bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: rgya gar yul gyi dur khrod gnas chen brgyad: bka' bab rig 'dzin so so'i thugs mdzod brdol: dpal chen sgrub pa bka' brgyad skur bzhengs tshe: dam la btags pa'i zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam rdzas dmar gyis (119)brgyan pa'i gtor ma longs: bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

hūm̐ bh+yo: tsha shod mang yul dpal mo'i sgrub pa'i mtshor: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i skur bstan pa: dam la btags pa'i dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang : bod skyong brtan ma chen po bcu gnyis dang : dge bsnyen bya btsan 'brog mo gnyen chen sogs: dam rdzas dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma long : bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin (120)las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: si ma la dang 'u yug mal gro klung: has po ri dang shams po mkha' ri dang : ti se gangs dang mchims pu shel brag dang : mkhar chu bsam yas khra 'brug la sogs dang : khyad par stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub tu: dpal chen rdo rje gro lod skur bstan te: bod yul mtha' dbus gter gyis gtams byas nas: dam la btags pa'i gza' klu rgyal gsum dang : gangs can dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs rnams kyis: dam (121)rdzas dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma longs: bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: phan bde rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang : mtha' dmag bzlog la nad gdon gnod pa srungs: chos rgyal rje yi brgyud pa bu bzhin skyongs: sad ser mu ge byad phur rbod gtong bzlog: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' phrin las mdzod: sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig: rak+sha si: bzhi pa brtan ma skyong ba ni// thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa las/ bh+yo: tshogs dang bka' yi bdag (122)nyid ni: khrag 'thung rdo rje nam mkha'i yum: gangs ri can gyi yul lha ni: bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: tshur spyon tshur spyon gtor ma longs: rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dang : dus sbyor bcu gnyis gnas dag pa: bal bod mtshams na tshe ring ma: la stod rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : gnod sbyin gang la kun bzang mo: 'brog chen 'khor 'dul bgegs kyi gtso: jo mo gangs rar spyan gcig ma: byang na mkha' lding klu mo (123)rgyal: kha rag rdo rje khyung btsun ma: rma chen spom rar drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo bod khams skyong :

'brog btsun rdo rje sman gcig ma: jo mo nag rgyal g.yur mo bsil: dbus na rdo rje zu le sman: kun kyang pad+ma'i bka' nyan te: dam la gnas shing rigs la 'go: tha tshig bzhin du gtor ma longs: mtha' yi dmag dang rgya 'dre'i 'tshubs: mu stegs 'gyu ba'i sgo 'phrang dang : 'gong po spun dgu'i (124)nad dal srungs: rtag chad thar par 'khrul pa yi: 'jigs tshogs lta ba dbu mar zlog: bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi: bstan pa dar ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ la la: le le: taṃ taṃ: te te: kha rak+ma: ma ma sring 'gro ma hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ hūm̐: lnga pa rdo rje'i bro yis gzir/ hūm̐: e yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: rgyud drug gnas pa'i sems can gyi: 'khor ba'i lam lnga dgag pa'i phyir: yig 'bru 'khrigs pa'i bro brdung bas: rgyud drug 'bros khung (125)gcod pa'i rgya: dug gsu ma rdul phran bzhin du bshigs: phung po khams dang skye mched tshogs: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyis 'khor da: sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor bas: phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig: ha ha ru lu ha ha ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa: drug pa mchod pa gong ltar ram/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kro dha ma hā sh+ma sha na puṣ+paṃ dhu paṃ dī paṃ gan+dhaṃ rū+u pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa par+she dharma pañtsa rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa bstod pa gzhung ltar ram// zin bris khams gsum rol pa las/ baiḍūr sngon po (126)rin chen ri rab dbus: nyi ma stong gi 'od zer 'bar ba ltar: sems dpa' sngon po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can: dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'od phu+ung stug po sprin ltar 'thibs pa yi: 'jigs byed rngams stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs: za byed bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yis: gdug pa zhal du 'dren la phyag 'tshal bstod: mi bzad mche bas brgyan pa'i zal gdangs shing : khams (127)gsum za bar byed pa'i rkan sgra can: nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis:

bgegs dpung bsregs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: brgyad pa nongs pa bshags pa ni/ bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar zhing gzir: ma rig dbang gis smin po rgyud lngar 'khyams: log rtog ngan pa'i dbang bsgyur 'gal 'khrul rnams: ye shes gzigs mnga' 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya lan gsum dgu pa ni/ brten bzhugs/ 'dir ni (128)gzugs sogs brjod/ bcu pa rtag pa'i mtha' bsal ba/ hūm̐: ngo mtshar sprul pa'i 'khor lo ma lus pa: ma skyes sems kyi dkyil 'khor chen por thim: chos rnams rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi ngang : ye shes lnga rdzogs stong nyid dam pa'i mdzod: a a a: bcu gcig chad pa'i mtha' bsal ba/ slar yang khams gsum 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: 'gro drug mun sel dbang chen gro bo lod: sgeg pa'i nyams kyis sgeg pa'i gar mdzod cig: bcu gnyis bsngo ba smon lam ni/ ho: lha (129)mchog bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i dge ba 'dis: sems la nyams kyi snang ba nang du 'char: lus la gar gyi snang ba phyi ru 'char: ngag la bden pa sngags kyi snang ba 'char: yul snang zhen pa rgyal ba'i thugs su shar: sku gsum rmi lam sgyu 'dra'i don rtogs shog: bcu gsum bkra shis brjod pa ni/ 'chi med zla gam dmar po dbang gi dkyil: skye shi gnyis med mgon po tshe mtha' yas: thugs rje sgyu ma'i rol pa rta mchog dpal:(130)sprul pa'i khro bo 'chol ba gro bo lod: sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam mi khyab: cir yang ston cing cir yang snang ba yi: gcig tu ma nges yon tan phrin las rnams: cis kyang ma bsgribs khams gsum rnam par rgyal: bden pa des kyang 'dir ni bde legs stsol: stong gsum 'jig rten mi mjed sprul pa'i zhing : sprul pa'i gar bsgyuraston pa bsam mi khyab: bstan gnyis nyi zla zung gcig 'khor zhing snang : bden (131)pa des kyang 'dir ni bde legs stsol: khyad par bsil ldan rwa ba dkar por sgyur:

mthong thos dran reg byang chub lam la bkod: mtha' dbus med par rin chen gter gyis gtams: bden pa des kyang 'dir ni bde legs stsol: 'gro ba'i gdul bya so so'i snang ngo ru: khyod kyi phrin las sprul sku 'ja' ltar shar: 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar 'bar: bden pa des kyang 'dir ni bde legs stsol: spyi (132) don gsum pa rjes kyi las// bcu dgu'i dang po zor rdzas sgrub// grol nyin bzlog 'phyang rdzogs pa dang*// gong ltar mchod bstod nongs pa bshags// o rgyan gter bdag gling pas gsungs/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur/ slar yang gtor chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa skad cig gis 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srid gsum gang ba nad mtshon dug gi char 'bebs pas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la (133)rngams par gyur: rtsa ba'i sngags dang lok+t+ri'i gsham/ trig nan myag thuṃ ha na da ha pa tsa mug mug thib thib hed hed bh+yo zlog phaṭa: zor mā ra ya zor ya: e sa bh+yo bzlog rbad ya: zhes zor rdzas rno ngar bskyed// bden stobs gong ltar thal mo brdab/ gnyis pa thun gtor 'gugs pa dang*// dmag ltor btab tshul mnan pa bzhin// shes rab snying po bdud bzlog bya// gsum pa sgo dbye sgab dkris bsal// rdul tshon dkar pos zor lam gtod// rol pa gtor bzlog las/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor na: phyag rgya bzhi ldan sgo srung rnams: (134) thugs rje'i thabs kyi phyag rgya dang : stong nyid shes rab dgongs pa yis: pho brang rnams kyi sgo dbye zhig: dbang chen rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams: dbyings la rtsol rtog mi mnga' yang : byams pa chen pos gdul dka' rnams: snying rje'i mthu yis sgrol ba'i phyir: dga' ba chen po'i gar dgu'i nyams: btang snyoms chen po'i klong nas bskyod:

bskyod dang skyong byed mi mnga' yang : dmar chen gtor ma chen po dang :(135)gnyis med rol pa'i dmag dpung 'di: brgya byin g.yul ngor chas pa 'dra: ri rab dag kyang mgo mjug ldog: rgya mtsho 'chol zhing skar tshogs 'khrugs: lha min mgo bo 'gas byed na: ldang ba'i dgra la smos ci 'tshal: de phyir pho brang sgo phye la: shul lam dgra bo'i phyogs su ston: bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: bzhi pa thugs dam bskul ba dang*// lnga pa chad tho gzhung ltar btang*// drug pa gom pa brgyad (136) bcu'i mtshams/ gtor tshugs steng du thugs dam bskul// lam sel brngan sbyin gser skyems dang*// dkar gtor dmar gtor gnyis kyang btegs// rol ba chen po gtor bzlog las/ hūm̐ḥ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcur: gnas pa'i che rgu gnyan rgu rnams: dbang phyug nga yi zor lam la: ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig: steng gi nyi zla sgra gcan nas: 'og gi sa bdag lto 'phye'i bar: rtag chags lha srin gnyan po la: zor sna gtad pa'i gnas med kyi: steng na bzhugs pa zhabs (137)bsdus shig: brngan du dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul: bar na bzhugs pa logs su byol: brngan du g.yu sngon phud kyis bran: 'og na bzhugs pa dbu chum zhig: brngan du dmar gtor gser skyems 'bul: bdag gi zor sna gnyan po'i lam: phyogs rnams rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings: brgyud nas dam nyams dgra bo dang : rgyal ba'i bka' la mi nyan pa'i: 'byung po'i tshogs la 'phangs (138)pa'i phyir: las kyi stongs grogs gnyen po mdzod: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod:

gtaur ma 'bul zhing gser skyems gtor// bdun sa drag po'i thebs dang bstun// gang du 'phang ba'i sar phyin la// thugs dam bskul pa gong ltar btang*// brgyad pa rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud ma'i// gser skyems srid pa'i dkar gtor ni// lo tsā dharmā shrī'i gsung*/ ho: lo rgyal po/ zla ba blon po/ zhag dmag mi/ dus tshod mtshon cha/ srid pa gsum gyi yab yum gnam sa/ g.yas gdags ri dkar po skyes pa pho'i bla ri/ g.yon srib (139)ri nag po za ma mo yi bla ri/ mtshams bzhi bu tsha nor gyis bsdus pa'i yul 'dir gnas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag bsen mo/ shar phyogs 'byung ba shing gi lha// lho phyogs 'byung ba me yi lha// nub phyogs 'byung ba lcags kyi lha// byang phyogs 'byung ba chu yi lha// mtshams bzhi 'byung ba sa yi lha// shar gyi stag skya bo/ lho'i g.yu 'brug sngon mo/ nub kyi bya dmar po/ byang gi rus sbal nag (140)po/ dbus kyi spre'u ser po/ mtshams bzhi g.yog brgyad dmangs kyi lha the se rgyal po la sogs te lo'i sa bdag 'brug lha ga pa la sogs te zla ba'i sa bdag gser mdzod ser po la sogs te zhag gi sa bdag g.yu mdzod sngon mo la sogs te zhag gi dus tshos kyi sa bdag shing pho byi ba la sogs te lo drug cu'i lha/ me stag la sogs te zla ba'i lha/ sa stag la sogs te zhag gi lha/ lcags yos (141)la sogs kyi ste dus tshod kyi lha/ lo zla dus bzhi'i sa bdag spar kha brgyad kyi lha/ sme ba dgu'i lha/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dus lha 'byung po'i lha/ phyed gnyis dang zer gnyis su rgyu/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha la sogs pa yul dus la dbang byed pa'i sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la rang gi spyod yul dang mthun pa'i gtor ma rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba gser skyems kyis brgyan pa'i (142)mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ so so'i rgyud tshims pa dang longs spyod kyi rkyen du 'byor par gyur cig

bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la che bas ma bkyon/ chung bas ma 'khang*/ ru nga dang phrag dog ma mdzad/ bdag ni sa dang dus la dbang mi byed do/ sa dang yul dus kyi bdag po khyod rnams la brten nas las dang bya ba byed pa yin pas stongs dang grogs cig bkra shis bde legs (143)phun sum tshogs pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul// dgu pa dgra bo'i yul mkhar zhing*// mi nor kha rje dbang thang bcas// hom du dgug gzhug byas pa la// bya gcan gzan la rbad pa bzhin// zor rdzas dug mtshon dmag dpung bskul// rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog las/ hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i pho nya rnams: mig nas khrag gi tshwa tshwa 'phro: kha nas bh+yo bzlog phaṭa sgra sgrogs: ral pa sprugs pa'i skra gseb nas: khro chu khol ma'i skyin thang 'bebs: rkang lag lcags kyi sder mo (144)yis: gnam sa med par sbar gyis 'debs: ri klung med par rjes kyis 'gengs: zas su sems can gson po za: brnag pa'i gnas su yud kyis phyin: gang la bya ba'i dgra bgegs gnyis: ma thogs myur du khrid la shog: dang po zhe sdang pha yis bskyed: bar du 'dod chags ma yi mngal: de nas dri za nye bar 'khor: tha ma nyon mongs dug lnga'i rten: phung po khams dang skye mched dang : tshogs brgyad rtsad nas gcad pa'i phyir: (145)klad pa'i dkyil du rdo zor ya: nyan pa'i rna la mtshe zor ya: lta ba'i mig la mda' zor ya: snom pa'i sna la khrag zor ya: smra ba'i lce la phur zor ya: dran pa'i snying la dug zor ya: 'gro ba'i rkang la mtshon zor ya: yul mkhar khyim la me zor ya: nor gyi dbyig la sgang zor ya: 'og gi rta la rtsang zor ya: mchan gyi bu la yungs zor (146)ya: rabs chad dud pas skye rgyud chod: ri rud phung pos yul mkhar bsgyel: kong zor 'bar bas cham la phob: tshon sku sna lngas byad du chug: tsher ma'i shing gi gnod gdug slongs:

tshon skud sna lngas byad du chug: tsher ma'i shing gi gnod gdug slongs: mda' khras skyes pa gri 'thab sbyor: 'phang khras bud med dug sbyor g.yos: lcags zangs dug khrag myos su chug: khram shing gshin rje'i kha ru rdzongs: lo zla zhag tu ma 'gyangs par: ming tsam med par phung du chug: tsit+ta ku lu nan: tsakra (147)raṃ: shag shag raṃ: khā hi raṃ: su tri ni: dza tri dza: ya ya: zor cha bcu gcig so sor yang*// sbyar ba kun bzang gzhan phan lugs// bcu pa bzlog 'phyang gong ltar gyer// bcu gcig zor chen 'phang ba ni// slar yang 'gug pa dang bcas pas/ dzaḥbh+yo rbad: bh+yo: do nub drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs pa: zhes sogs brjod nas gtor chen rbud// bcu gnyis me chus mtshams bcad la// srung ba'i 'khor lo gong bzhin bsgom// rdo rje slob dpon rting mnan ldog /bcu gsum sgo drung brtan gtor bshams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ bh+yo: tshogs dang (148)bka' yi sogs kyis 'bul/ bcu bzhi dong du liṅga brub// 'gug gzhug dang bcas bro yis mnan/ hūm̐ḥ e yi dkyis 'khor la sogs brjod/ bco lnga gtor gzhong nang du 'bru// gtor zhing 'chi med zla gam sogs/ shis pa brjod cing dang du longs// bcu drug 'chi med tshe 'gugs pa// rig 'dzin tshe sgrub bzhin du bya// bcu bdun dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bh+rum̐ skyes gtor ma lha yi gzhal yas khang : yid 'od rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan: bcud kyi dam rdzas gtso bo thabs shes dang : mtheb kyu 'khor tshogs sprul pa ging (149)gi tshogs: skal ldan bu la gtor mas dbang bskur bas: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku: sku yi byin rlabs slob ma'i lus la zhugs: bde ba chen po lus la dbang bskur bas: na tsha sdug bsngal 'khrul pa'i snang zhen sbyang : hūm̐ hrīḥ bde gshegs yab yum sbyor ba'i byang chub sems: dri med bdud rtsi gsang ba'i dbang chen po:
